## Selected Case Studies

- [Fi El Sekka Case Study](https://my-website-neon-ten-94.vercel.app/work/fi-el-sekka) · [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/eg/app/fi-el-sekka/id6813012849): Intercity shuttle booking and digital wallet app in Egypt with instant QR seat boarding passes, route tracking, and verified captains.
- [Tride Case Study](https://my-website-neon-ten-94.vercel.app/work/tride) · [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/eg/app/tride-egypt/id6749056619) / [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.corevine.trideuser&pcampaignid=web_share): Trusted school ride-booking app built at Corevine giving parents flexible car or seat plans, multi-child profiles, and verified school routes.
- [Active Case Study](https://my-website-neon-ten-94.vercel.app/work/active-platform) · [Live Website](https://activksa.com/brands/): End-to-end Saudi brand campaign discovery and creator matching web platform crafted for clarity and conversion.
- [Malahi Case Study](https://my-website-neon-ten-94.vercel.app/work/malahi) · [Live Website](https://malahi.com/ar): Bilingual multi-brand Saudi entertainment and ticketing web flagship uniting Wanoos, Doos Karting, Garage, and Remote.
- [Yusr Academy Case Study](https://my-website-neon-ten-94.vercel.app/work/yusr-academy) · [Live Website](https://www.yusr-academy.com/): Arabic-first UI/UX design academy and studio platform pairing practical case-study training with Vibe Coding mentorship.

## Experience & Mentorship

- **Product & UI/UX Designer — Corevine (Egypt)**: End-to-end mobile & web product delivery including Tride (live on App Store & Google Play), Figma component systems, and engineering QA.
- **Independent Product Designer — Egypt & KSA Product Teams (MENA)**: Partnering with founders and product teams to design and launch live regional mobile & web platforms (Fi El Sekka, Active KSA, Malahi).
- **UI/UX Mentor & Prototyping Instructor — Yusr Academy (MENA)**: Mentoring Arabic UI/UX designers on real-world case studies, product thinking, and AI-assisted Vibe Coding workflows.
